$comment: Each budget is a reading plus a margin: 5% for sizes, 10% for counts (M5.7, D69, docs/specs/performance.md#the-budgets). A change that adds weight on purpose raises the budget with its new reading and date, in the same change. Sizes are checked by pnpm budgets after the build, counts by perf.spec.ts: the grove's glade with a box, framed on a 1280 x 900 desktop, orbited 50 degrees, every plant's model drawn.

editor-start.of: zlib's gzip at level 9 of index.html, its module, every chunk that module imports statically, and its stylesheets, each file on its own

scene-view.of: zlib's gzip at level 9 of the SceneView chunk and the chunks it imports statically that the start doesn't: three, the view and its parts

models-view.of: zlib's gzip at level 9 of the modelsView chunk and the chunks it imports statically that the start and the view don't: the loaders and decoders

walk.of: zlib's gzip at level 9 of runtime/walk.js (M5.8): three, Rapier's compat build with its wasm inline, the Draco and Basis decoders, and the stage, the one file every page loads to walk a space

nav.of: zlib's gzip at level 9 of runtime/nav.js (M6.2): Recast and Detour through recast-navigation-js, their wasm inline, loaded beside walk.js only for a space with a navmesh, and by Bake navigation's worker

precache.of: bytes of every file the service worker precaches, as a device keeps them; walk.js (6.9 MB) since M5.8, nav.js (0.8 MB) since M6.2

space-wrecked-web.of: bytes of every file of Space-Wrecked's web export (M4.12), with about 4% room for its content

trail-web.of: bytes of every file of the trail's web export (M5.8): walk.js beside the runtime, and the trail's world in the page
